goal: Classify why a nominally dynamic open-schema Production operator fit TRAIN but failed relation transfer, open-schema transfer, and traversal generalization.
procedure: Treat the full trajectory as model evidence. Compare TRAIN loss collapse with DEV factor trajectories. Re-open the exact current code and independently localized side-branch evidence. Audit not only explicit relation tables but any trainable metric or fixed class head capable of recreating an implicit closed ontology.
decision_criteria: TRAIN relation/factor losses become small while DEV relation exact stays low
open-schema exact peaks early then collapses
traversal DEV remains pinned despite near-zero TRAIN traversal loss
authority: Valid failure evidence requiring architecture review. Does not authorize an automatic P2-v4 repair run.
validation: Failure trajectory is preserved; P3 was not authorized; frozen native final validation remained unopened.
failure_or_lesson: Removing an explicit relation-ID table is insufficient if a trainable six-label semantic metric can rotate into an implicit ontology. Static dynamic-cardinality tests can pass while true unseen-schema transfer still fails.
notes: Also exposed that fixed traversal/role/control heads remained small lexical classifiers despite product-level no-ceiling language.

goal: Determine whether final architecture recomposition accidentally discarded an independently supported repair while preserving a different valid architectural correction.
procedure: Compare source-level mechanisms across maximal experiment heads instead of treating newer branch naming as automatic supersession. Map each mechanism to the evidence that justified it and require final recomposition to preserve mutually compatible proven requirements.
constraints: do not restore sparse relation selection merely because the ordered branch used it
decision_criteria: ordered branch contains explicit token-position coverage/remaining-evidence state
final core preserves continuous relation hypotheses but lacks that coverage state
authority: Process lesson plus architecture requirement. Does not independently authorize compute.
validation: Original sources on both branches were inspected and the two requirements were found compatible: continuous hypotheses plus ordered evidence consumption.
failure_or_lesson: A final architecture can regress by dropping a previously localized mechanism during branch recomposition. Supersession must be mechanism-aware and evidence-aware, not branch-name-aware.

goal: Replace the failing closed-class semantic induction boundary with one full closure package before another GPU launch.
procedure: Add a public P2S schema-generalization stage using a relation-identity-independent candidate-conditioned matcher. Gate it on unseen auxiliary relation meanings. Freeze it before Production P2. Restore differentiable relation-grounded query-token coverage while retaining continuous relation hypotheses. Replace opaque factor class heads with semantic factor schemas. Reuse proven P1, Binder v2, P4 policy, and the original frozen native final gate.
constraints: actual Production open and final relation meanings excluded from P2S TRAIN and auxiliary holdout
no relation-identity/candidate-count/hop parameter axis in matcher
decision_criteria: closure mechanics and source contracts pass
unseen auxiliary schema boundary is structurally isolated
exact sparsity remains in structural Binder v2
single runner preserves original final holdout lineage
authority: Static/CPU qualification of the package. Authorizes no claim of N0 completion; model evidence still requires the governed Magnolia closure run.
validation: All closure workflow steps passed: compile, mechanics, failure authority, holdout isolation, reusable matcher contract, frozen matcher/ordered operator contract, unchanged Production gates, structural sparsity boundary, and single-launch frozen-final lineage.
failure_or_lesson: Break a repair loop by changing the missing capability boundary once and adding a test that directly measures the property previous static tests missed. Here that property is unseen semantic schema generalization, not merely runtime candidate cardinality.
